sourceDerivation.proof: Iterate layers in order and remove LONG_EDGE via the same iterator. At a dummy the current incoming original segment survives; the outgoing segment supplies the old final target. Repeating the same operation at subsequent dummies recovers the entire original edge without returning a new ID or keeping detached generated segments.

Append surviving bends first, then copy dropped bend/junction vectors in iteration order. The fixed JUNCTION_POINTS default is an empty cloneable KVectorChain. Property.getDefault69799-69811 clones it and PropertyHolder.getProperty25438-25439 stores that clone. Thus both join reads materialize independent empty chains even with no public junction output. JS vector-chain objects are truthy even when empty, so host presence checks must not use Python empty-list truthiness. No labels implies the labels loop is empty; final restoration does not create or rename sections itself.

guardProofs.proof: The admitted flat weakly connected DAG has one actual component. Assign LNode IDs in current layerless work order, then perform the source ordered DFS (ports, incoming then outgoing) to determine private NGraph node order. Initialize private edges in source-node/port/outgoing order. Even if import already traversed a component, repeat this layerer DFS; it is not a no-op proof. previousLayeringNodeCounts stays null because connectedComponents.size==1.

Topological FIFO gives feasible integer ranks for unit delta on a DAG. Tight DFS rooted at the FIRST private node grows only to non-tree nodes or traverses already marked tree edges. If its node count<n, weak connectivity supplies a crossing edge; minimal nonnegative slack with the source orientation sign shifts the current tree, preserves feasibility, and makes at least one new crossing edge tight. At most n-1 node additions produce a connected tight spanning tree. Every true tree edge has directed rank difference1. No assumption that the first node is a source is permitted.

Compute actual postorder intervals and leaf-propagated cutvalues in source list order. For a tree edge, endpoint subtree intervals are nested: isInHead returns the component containing the directed target after deleting that edge. Preserve its literal condition. leaveEdge picks first insertion-ordered tree edge cut<-1e-10; enterEdge picks first strict-min slack crossing head->outside. Removing leave and adding enter retains a tree; shifting the outside by -slack makes enter tight while other tree edges keep difference1 and all directed edge spans stay>=1. Recompute postorder/cutvalues exactly. Degenerate exchanges still stop at the source iteration limit; do not continue to a textbook optimum.

A connected n-node tight tree with unit directed gaps has rank range<=n-1; a path between minimum and maximum visits every intervening integer rank, so normalized filling is nonempty in every layer. Source balance moves only equal-degree nodes and only to a strictly smaller filling. Such nodes either have incoming/outgoing neighbors or are the isolated singleton. minimalSpan literal ternary yields the true min incoming span and an outgoing bound no larger than the true min outgoing span (a non-min incoming edge may also reduce that bound). Thus its candidate ranks stay strictly between predecessors and successors. Since all candidate layers initially have count>=1, a moved-from layer had count>=2 and cannot be emptied. The singleton range is empty. Source balancing therefore retains feasible spans, no empty layer, and at most n layers. Do not rewrite the minimalSpan ternary into a different standard formula.

This phase runs BEFORE dummy creation, so n<=8 and m<=28. The literal >=40 removeSubtrees condition is false. Initial ranks are integers0..7. During at most7 feasible-tree growth shifts a loose range recurrence Rnext<=2R+1 bounds transient ranges below1024. After the tight tree exists its range is<=7; at most84 exchanges shift one cut by a crossing slack whose magnitude is<=6, so all temporary ranks have magnitude well below4096. Cutvalue sums are bounded integral combinations of at most28 unit edges on an8-node tree (a conservative bound28*2^8=7168 suffices); filling/IDs/counters also stay far below2^31 and2^53. Host exact integer arithmetic equals JS binary64 integer results here. The only sqrt/round operates on integer n1..8, away from half-integer rounding boundaries. These are source-derived bounds, not observed-coordinate tolerances.

After layer assignment and default no-op layer constraints, every original edge has forward rank gap>=1, at most n-1, with all normalized intermediate ranks occupied. Sort original nodes by rank and current source order within a rank. An edge from topological positions i<j has gap-1<=j-i-1. No parallel edges means total new dummies=sum_edges(gap-1)<=sum_i<j(j-i-1)=C(n,3). For n8 this is56 dummies/64 internal nodes, and E+dummy<=28+56=84 segments. Per-original-edge implicit ports plus two per dummy give at most168 ports. This bound is for later phases; the NS >=40 branch must never use the post-split count.
